name: com.allratestoday/central-bank-mcp
title: Central Bank Rates (AllRatesToday)
description: Official exchange rates from 121 central banks + 3 tax authorities. No API key needed to start.

environmentVariables.name: ALLRATES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server runs keyless: the latest published table of any source plus the source catalogue. A free key (https://allratestoday.com/register, free) unlocks cross-bank comparison and publication calendars; dated tables and time series need a paid plan.
